scripts.build:admin: node scripts/run.mjs tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.admin.json && node scripts/run.mjs vite build --config vite.admin.config.ts
scripts.dev: node scripts/run.mjs node scripts/pdf-assets.mjs && node scripts/run.mjs vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: node scripts/run.mjs tsc --noEmit && node scripts/run.mjs node scripts/build.mjs
